appearance_facts.fact: Title: 'Risk Index of Hazard H in US States'
Legend: Color scale from 'Low' (dark red, value 0) to 'High' (yellow, value 100)
States are colored according to their Risk Index value for Hazard H, using a gradient from dark red to yellow
States with the darkest red color (e.g., WA, ID, WY, NM, KS) have the lowest risk index (near 0)
States with the lightest yellow color (e.g., MT, OR, NV, UT, TX, FL) have the highest risk index (near 100)
States like RI, NJ, NY, VT, NH are colored dark red, indicating low risk
States like OH, IN, IL, TN, GA, SC, NC, VA, WV, PA are colored orange or light orange, indicating moderate risk
States like SD, NE, MO, IA, MN, WI, MI, KY, MS, AL, AR, LA, OK are colored orange or light orange, indicating moderate risk

printed_facts.fact: State abbreviations are printed inside each state (e.g., WA, ID, NM, RI, DE)
States with low risk (dark red) include: WA, ID, WY, NM, KS, RI, NJ, VT, NH
States with high risk (yellow) include: MT, OR, NV, UT, TX, FL
States with moderate risk (orange) include: SD, NE, MO, IA, MN, WI, MI, KY, MS, AL, AR, LA, OK, OH, IN, IL, TN, GA, SC, NC, VA, WV, PA
